Subject: Integration: FlowSDK runtime instrumentation for Redwood

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — we loved Redwood's smart routing and caching. We have a customer pilot that requires FlowSDK (our real-time orchestration SDK) to emit traces and token-level metadata into your tracing hooks so customers can reconcile latency and cost per request.

Attached: Synthetix_FlowSDK_Integration_Guide.pdf (overview + API surface). High level asks:
- Verify LangChain and LlamaIndex connector compatibility for FlowSDK calls.
- Add a small tracing shim so FlowSDK spans appear in Redwood traces with request_id.
- Define acceptance criteria and test vectors so our mutual customers can run an integration smoke test.

Can we schedule a short technical sync next week? I can loop in our lead engineer Simon.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Parkel
Head of Platform Partnerships
SynthetixAI

Elena — thanks for the guide, it looks promising. Marissa (cc) will own the technical onboarding; I’ll coordinate legal/partner ops.

- LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations are on our roadmap; we need a short plugin shim on your side or a small adapter on ours depending on where you want the instrumentation to live.

Next steps:
1) Technical sync (30m) with Simon + Marissa next Tue/Wed.
2) Marissa will draft acceptance criteria and a smoke test plan.
3) I’ll send the partner terms and ask for an executed NDA if not already done.

Are you available Tue 5/18 10:00 PT?

Best,

- We have a LangChain wrapper (flowsdklangchain v0.3) and a LlamaIndex connector sample. They both currently surface an event bus that should map to OpenTelemetry span events.

See you Tue.

—Elena
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration: FlowSDK runtime instrumentation for Redwood

Elena / team — great sync this morning. Below is the draft acceptance criteria and smoke test we discussed. Please confirm or propose edits.

Acceptance criteria (v1):
- Tracing: FlowSDK spans are visible in Redwood traces with the following attributes: request_id, flow_step, token_count, model_name.
- LangChain: flowsdklangchain wrapper can be plugged into a Redwood-hosted runtime and produce identical outputs to the baseline (no regression in response text).
- LlamaIndex: connector returns the same index queries when run against our sample index.
- Performance: 95th percentile added latency due to our shim must be < 25ms on dedicated capacity for sequences <= 1024 tokens.
- Test vectors: we will run the provided demo-harness against a Redwood staging endpoint and share logs.

Test plan / tasks:
1) Synthetix provides instrumented demo harness + small test corpus (you already did).
2) Redwood spins up a staging runtime and enables tracing hooks.
3) Run smoke test; both teams review trace logs and token counts.
4) Sign-off = green traces + matching response content + performance within SLA.

Notes: please upload the demo-harness to the shared Drive link and grant access to marissa_cole@redwood.com. I’ve opened a ticket to track the engineering work: INT-1229 (link below).

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
